In a report Friday, the company detailed "unintended model actions," including submitting a false tip regarding an unsolved murder, that led to the decision. Although the impact of these behaviors was…

title: Lens see off Lyon as Ligue 1 season resumes after international break
summary: Lens put an end to a four-match winless run by beating Lyon 2-1 on Friday night, in what was the first Ligue 1 fixture after a three-week international break. Paris Saint-Germain head coach Luis Enrique has brushed off concerns about Ousmane Dembélé's recent form, having rested the forward for Saturday's match against promoted side Le Mans.

title: NATO top commander to warn Russia over alliance’s ability to counter-attack
summary: NATO’s top military commander is expected to warn Russia on Monday that the alliance can counter any attack, officials said. US General Alexus Grynkewich will outline his “theory of victory” at a Warsaw security conference amid Western concerns over Moscow’s alleged campaign of sabotage and interference against Ukraine’s wartime backers.

title: War in Ukraine: Russian strikes kill 15, including a young girl
summary: Early Saturday, Russia targeted residential neighbourhoods in the southeastern city of Zaporizhzhia with "five guided aerial bombs", according to Ukraine's National Police. At least 15 people were killed, including three children, Ukraine's State Emergency Service said. The family of a young girl killed in the attack was inconsolable.

title: Ukraine says ready to halt refinery strikes if Moscow stops energy attacks
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Sunday said Kyiv was ready to halt strikes Russian oil refineries if Moscow stopped attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure. Zelensky also pushed back on US President Donald Trump's comments made Saturday evening calling for Ukraine to elect a new leader by saying, "It's up to our people".

title: Live: Russian strikes on Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia kill at least seven, including children
summary: Russian strikes on the southeastern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia killed at least eight people including three children, regional authorities said on Saturday, as US, Ukrainian and European officials met in Miami for fresh talks aimed at finding a path to end Russia's war in Ukraine. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

title: Fresh Houthi strike hits Riyadh airport a day after deadly attack
summary: A fresh Houthi strike hit Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport on Sunday, killing a Pakistani resident and wounding 11, Saudi authorities said. The attack followed a strike that killed at least 12 people and halted airport operations on Saturday. The Iran-backed group threatened further attacks on Saudi Arabia’s transit hubs.

title: Kenya: Ebola tests negative as contact tracing continues
summary: Tests have come back negative for a person suspected of having Ebola who was reportedly in quarantine at a hospital, following rumours circulating over the past 24 hours. Meanwhile, in Nairobi, authorities are racing to trace contacts of Kenya's first Ebola death, reported on Monday. Our correspondent Bastien Renouil tells us more.

title: La Fédération portugaise de football ouvre une procédure disciplinaire contre Ronaldo
summary: Une procédure disciplinaire a été ouverte contre Cristiano Ronaldo après son départ d'un rassemblement de l'équipe nationale le 30 septembre, a annoncé samedi la Fédération portugaise de football. D'après les médias portugais, selon le règlement, un joueur ayant manqué un entraînement, un match ou une activité de la sélection risque une suspension de un à s…

title: Mobilisations lycéennes : des risques de sanctions académiques ?
summary: Au lendemain de la promesse du déploiement en urgence de 3.000 professeurs remplaçants, le mouvement lycéen est en "nette décélération", s'est-on félicité vendredi au sein de l'exécutif, même si quelque 150 établissements sont restés fermés et qu'une nouvelle journée de mobilisation est prévue mardi. Quelles seront les conséquences pour les élèves ayant man…

title: El Nino breaks Pacific temperature record as weather pattern intensifies
summary: An intensifying El Nino pushed sea surface temperatures in a key Pacific monitoring region to a record 29.70C in September, the EU’s Copernicus climate service said Monday. Forecasters expect the weather pattern, which raises drought and flood risks and exacerbates global warming, to become the strongest ever recorded this year.

title: Live: EU’s top diplomat says she will welcome Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire ‘when it holds’
summary: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said Monday that the bloc would welcome a truce on striking energy infrastructure between Ukraine and Russia "when it holds", after US President Donald Trump unilaterally announced a ceasefire that seemed to catch both Kyiv and Moscow off guard. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

title: Convicted murderer Christa Pike leaves hospital, returns to prison after botched execution
summary: Christa Pike's lawyers on Saturday said that the 50-year-old convicted murderer has been discharged from the hospital and returned to prison. Pike was transported to the hospital in critical condition on September 30 after she survived Tennessee's botched effort to execute her for murdering a classmate when she was a teenager.

title: Slovenia rejects bill in blow to PM Janez Jansa’s reform agenda
summary: Slovenians rejected a bill expanding parliamentary inquiry powers in a referendum Sunday, dealing a blow to nationalist Prime Minister Janez Jansa. With 99 percent of votes counted, 51 percent opposed the proposal and 49 percent backed it in the binding vote. The opposition had denounced his reform agenda as "authoritarian".

title: Saudi-led coalition says new attack at Riyadh airport causes fire, day after strike kills 12
summary: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said an "unidentified projectile" had targeted Riyadh's international airport on Sunday, causing a fire. The incident came hours after the Iran-backed Houthis warned airlines and travellers to stay away from Saudi airports. David Smith, The Guardian's Washington bureau chief, tells us more.

title: Abbas postpones Palestinian elections, sets presidential poll for September 2027
summary: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas on Saturday postponed legislative elections due next month until September 11, ​2027, and called ‌a presidential poll for the same date, blaming Israel and the security situation in the Palestinian territories for the ⁠delay. Our correspondent in Jerusalem Noga Tarnopolsky tells us more.

title: Raphaël Glucksmann officiellement candidat du PS, un "cap clair" et des zones d'ombre
summary: L’eurodéputé et patron du petit parti Place publique, Raphaël Glucksmann, a remporté dimanche soir la primaire de la gauche sociale-démocrate dès le premier tour. Une victoire nette pour la ligne anti-Mélenchon qu’il défendait et qu'il entend incarner en se présentant comme "le candidat de la gauche démocratique" à l'élection présidentielle de 2027.

title: ‘Saturday Night Live U.K.’: Here’s Where to Watch Season 2 Online for Free
summary: This weekend, SNL U.K. has Danny Dyer as host and Sasha Keable as musical guest.

title: Hunger and malnutrition stalk Gazans, a year on from ceasefire
summary: Every day, Gazan mother Niyaha al-Masri spends six exhausting hours or more queueing at a community kitchen in the hope of getting some food for her family. It has been a year since a ceasefire between Hamas and Israel was supposed to allow food to flood into the ruined territory, yet widespread hunger persists there.

title: Informe desde Ciudad de Panamá: declaran estado de emergencia tras el terremoto
summary: Tras el fuerte terremoto que sacudió Panamá el 9 de octubre, el Gobierno de Panamá declaró el estado de emergencia nacional para acelerar la asistencia a las comunidades afectadas y la reparación de infraestructuras dañadas, entre colegios, escuelas y hoteles. El saldo de muertos y desaparecidos fue de cero. Desde Ciudad de Panamá, nuestro corresponsal José…

summary: La astronauta francesa Sophie Adenot regresó a la Tierra tras pasar casi ocho meses en la Estación Espacial Internacional (EEI), un récord de estancia orbital ininterrumpida para un astronauta europeo. title: Christa Pike, condenada por asesinato, sale del hospital y regresa a prisión tras una ejecución fallida
summary: Los abogados de Christa Pike afirmaron el sábado 10 de octubre que la asesina condenada, de 50 años, ha recibido el alta hospitalaria y ha regresado a prisión. Pike fue trasladada al hospital en estado crítico el 30 de septiembre, tras sobrevivir al fallido intento de Tennessee de ejecutarla por el asesinato de una compañera de clase cuando era adolescente.

summary: ¿Castigo latino a Donald Trump en las urnas? Eso es lo que señala una reciente encuesta de 'NBC News' y 'Telemundo', que muestra una creciente desaprobación de los votantes de esta comunidad hacia la figura del actual presidente estadounidense. title: France: Can the left unite behind a single candidate?
summary: Five candidates are vying to lead France's social-democratic left in the 2027 presidential election, with a cyberattack disrupting the primary vote. Can the left unite behind one candidate? We discuss this with our guest Joseph Downing, Senior Lecturer in Politics and International Relations at Aston University.

title: India: liberan a los líderes de las "cucarachas" y convocan nuevas manifestaciones
summary: La justicia india ordenó este domingo 11 de octubre la liberación de tres líderes del movimiento de las "cucarachas", detenidos la víspera antes de una protesta contra la revisión de las listas electorales. Tras una jornada de represión policial y miles de detenciones, según la prensa local, el movimiento y la oposición convocaron nuevas manifestaciones

title: Raphaël Glucksmann largement élu candidat de la gauche sociale-démocrate pour la présidentielle
summary: Raphaël Glucksmann s'est imposé dimanche dès le premier tour à la primaire de la gauche sociale-démocrate. L'eurodéputé de 46 ans, qui a promis de "rassembler la gauche démocratique" pour "battre l'extrême droite" à la présidentielle, va devoir rassembler une famille politique divisée sur la question des alliances avec LFI, qu'il refuse.

title: Présidentielle au Brésil : l'équipe de Lula accuse Meta d'"interférences" dans la campagne
summary: L'équipe de campagne de Lula, président sortant du Brésil et candidat à sa réélection, a accusé samedi Meta, maison mère de Facebook, WhatsApp et Instagram, d'"interférences" en bloquant ses contenus. Le Tribunal supérieur électoral a donné 48 heures à Meta – qui dit "respecter les règles électorales" – pour répondre à ces accusations.

title: India court orders release of 'cockroach' movement leaders after detention
summary: An Indian court ordered the release of three leaders of the viral "cockroach" movement on Sunday, a day after their detention ahead of protests over alleged irregularities in voter-roll revisions. Upon his release, founder Abhijeet Dipke called Narendra Modi an "embarassment to India" in a social media post.

title: Middle East live: Riyadh airport attack 'not acceptable,' Trump says
summary: US President Donald Trump said Saturday that a deadly strike on Riyadh's international airport was "not acceptable". Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia vowed to retaliate against Yemen's Houthi rebels after the attack killed at least 12 people and wounded more than 300. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

title: Primaire sociale-démocrate : qui arrivera en tête à l'issue du premier tour ?
summary: Quelque 140 000 votants ont jusqu'à 18 h, dimanche, pour choisir parmi les cinq prétendants de la primaire sociale-démocrate : Jérôme Guedj, Emmanuel Maurel, Ségolène Royal, Olivier Faure ou Raphaël Glucksmann. Ce dernier, donné favori, espère être élu dès le premier tour après une cyberattaque qui a perturbé le processus électoral.

title: Un nuevo ataque atribuido a los rebeldes hutíes contra el aeropuerto de Riad deja varios heridos
summary: Un ataque atribuido a los rebeldes hutíes alcanzó este sábado 10 de octubre el aeropuerto de Riad. Los médicos fueron llamados de urgencia a los hospitales de la capital saudita ante una "grave situación de emergencia". Una fuente diplomática al tanto del ataque indicó a la AFP que un "misil" impactó contra el aeropuerto "alrededor de las 15:00".

title: Scores of gold miners killed in air strikes on Egypt-Sudan border, rights group says
summary: At least 72 workers were killed in air strikes on a gold mine on the Sudan-Egypt border on Saturday, a Sudanese rights group said on Sunday. The Emergency Lawyers organisation accused Egypt’s air force of the attack. AFP could not independently verify the account and Egypt has issued no official comment.

title: La OMS aún desconoce qué causó la muerte de una trabajadora de un laboratorio de peste en Rusia
summary: La Organización Mundial de la Salud informó que las pruebas realizadas a la trabajadora y a sus contactos dieron negativo para los patógenos de alto riesgo analizados y que no hay evidencia de una transmisión en curso. La mujer murió el 2 de octubre tras desarrollar una neumonía y las autoridades rusas pusieron en cuarentena a unas 200 personas.

title: Panamá declara el estado de emergencia ante los daños por el terremoto de magnitud 7,7
summary: El Gobierno de Panamá declaró el estado de emergencia nacional y anunció que destinará hasta 100 millones de dólares para atender los daños causados por el sismo, que dejó al menos 27 heridos y afectó cientos de viviendas y centros educativos. Más de un centenar de réplicas obligaron a parte de la población a pasar la noche en parques y calles.

title: Russian attack on Ukrainian city kills 15, a day after Trump eases diesel sanctions on Moscow
summary: Fifteen people, including three children, were killed in a Russian attack on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia on Saturday, a day after US President Donald Trump announced a deal to lift sanctions on Russian diesel, in a major setback for Kyiv. Our correspondent Gulliver Cragg tells us more.

title: EE. UU.: Isaías se convierte en ciclón postropical tras causar al menos dos muertes y apagones en EE. UU.
summary: Isaías dejó al menos dos muertos y más de 512.000 clientes sin electricidad en Florida y Alabama tras tocar tierra como huracán de categoría 2. Se debilitó este sábado hasta convertirse en un ciclón postropical, aunque persiste el riesgo de lluvias intensas e inundaciones. Estados Unidos aprobó declaraciones de emergencia para ambos estados.

title: Une nouvelle attaque imputée aux Houthis à l'aéroport de Riyad fait plusieurs victimes
summary: Une attaque imputée aux Houthis a visé l'aéroport de Riyad, samedi. Des médecins ont été appelés à se rendre d'urgence dans les hôpitaux de la capitale saoudienne, indiquant une "situation d'urgence grave". La source diplomatique, informée sur l'attaque, a indiqué à l'AFP qu'un "missile" avait frappé l'aéroport "vers 15 h 00".

title: El francés Paul Seixas gana el Giro de Lombardía y se convierte en su vencedor más joven
summary: Con solo 20 años, Paul Seixas ganó este sábado el Giro de Lombardía y se convirtió en el vencedor más joven de la historia de esta carrera, una de las más prestigiosas del ciclismo mundial. La promesa francesa se impuso en solitario tras atacar a unos 19 kilómetros de la meta, por delante del español Enric Mas y del italiano Giulio Ciccone.

title: Brasil: Lula denuncia restricciones de Meta en redes sociales antes del balotaje
summary: La campaña del presidente brasileño, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, denunció presuntas restricciones de Meta a sus publicaciones en redes sociales, a dos semanas del balotaje del 25 de octubre frente a Flávio Bolsonaro. El Tribunal Superior Electoral exigió explicaciones a la compañía, que rechazó las acusaciones de interferencia electoral.

title: Accord Moscou-Washington sur le pérole : quel impact en France ?
summary: ⁠Le président ​américain Donald Trump ​a annoncé vendredi qu'à l'issue d'une ​discussion "très ‌fructueuse" qu'il ⁠avait eue avec ‌son homologue russe Vladimir Poutine, ⁠la Russie avait accepté de ​livrer immédiatement plus ‌de 300 000 tonnes de diesel sur ‌les marchés américain et ​mondial. Quel sera l'impact en France ?

title: Death penalty: Why are executions increasing worldwide?
summary: October 10 marks the World Day Against the Death Penalty. This week, the EU condemned capital punishment as a cruel and degrading form of punishment. But not all world leaders share this view. We discuss why executions are on the rise with our guest François Picard, host of "Death Row Stories".

title: Spain: Sánchez and Feijóo launch campaigns
summary: Although Spain's general election is set to take place on November 29, the battle has already begun. Over the weekend, Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and his main conservative challenger, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, kicked off their pre-election rallies, targeting each other's key vulnerabilities.

title: India detains thousands, locks down Delhi to foil election chief protest
summary: Police detained more than 2,000 protesters and the founder of the "cockroach" youth movement in Delhi on Saturday as security forces locked down parts of the capital to thwart a rally demanding the resignation of India's election chief. Our correspondent Navodita Kumari tells us more.

title: Trump's energy ceasefire announcement was 'news for me' (Zelensky)
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told the Axios digital news outlet on Sunday that he was surprised by US counterpart Donald Trump's announcement of a Ukraine-Russia "energy ceasefire," but he would accept it whenever it begins. Our correspondent Gulliver Cragg tells us more.

title: Pope Leo says he will undergo surgery for small growth on lung
summary: Pope Leo said on Sunday that doctors had detected a small growth on his lung during a recent health check and he would be undergoing surgery this week to remove ​it, in the ‌first health scare of the 71-year-old pontiff's tenure. We discuss that with our correspondent Seema Gupta.

title: India's 'cockroach' movement: "This is unprecedented"
summary: Indian police detained Abhijeet Dipke, head of the satirical Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) movement, on Saturday ahead of a major protest against the Election Commission, the party said. "This is unprecedented," our guest Subir Sinha, director of the SOAS South Asia Institute, says.

title: India's 'cockroach' leaders vow to keep up election protests
summary: Leaders of India's online "cockroach" movement pledged on Sunday to continue their campaign against the election commissioner, hours after they were released from detention as authorities sought to thwart a major demonstration. Our correspondent Navodita Kumari tells us more.

title: Midterms: "It does look like the Republicans will lose control of the House of Representatives"
summary: Most of the political world is focused on next month's midterm elections in the US. "It does look like the Republicans will lose control of the House of Representatives," says our guest, Bruce Stokes, a visiting senior fellow at the German Marshall Fund of the United States.

title: México se prepara para el impacto del huracán Simón, de categoría 4, este domingo
summary: El huracán Simón se aproxima a las costas de Jalisco, México, donde se prevé que toque tierra este domingo hacia el mediodía como un ciclón de categoría 4. Su lento desplazamiento aumenta el riesgo de lluvias prolongadas, mientras las autoridades suspenden actividades no esenciales y evacúan poblaciones costeras.

title: Inde : les leaders des "cafards" remis en liberté, appels à de nouvelles manifestations
summary: La justice indienne a ordonné dimanche la remise en liberté des chefs du mouvement des "cafards", arrêtés la veille en amont d'une manifestation largement réprimée contre la révision des listes électorales. Les organisateurs de cette manifestation ont appelé à poursuivre la contestation dans la rue.

title: Trump urges Zelensky replacement as diesel row rages
summary: Donald Trump called on Saturday for Ukraine to "get a new leader" after Volodymyr Zelensky slammed Washington's easing of Russian diesel sanctions, as the US president faces fuel price pressure weeks before midterm elections. Our correspondent Gulliver Cragg tells us more.

title: Lens renoue avec la victoire contre Lyon pour le retour de la Ligue 1
summary: Avec sa victoire à domicile contre Lyon (2-1) pour le retour de la Ligue 1 après trois semaines, Lens a mis fin à une série de quatre rencontres sans victoire. Le Paris Saint-Germain affrontera Le Mans samedi soir sans Ousmane Dembélé ni Nuno Mendes, laissés au repos après la trêve internationale.
